lab_questions.title: Search Suggestions Matching Prefix
lab_questions.description:
An e-commerce product search engine powers real-time autocomplete suggestions. When a shopper types a search prefix, the system must immediately return the count of product keywords in the catalog that start with that exact prefix.

Read N (catalog keyword count) and Q (number of search prefix queries), followed by N product keywords and Q query prefixes. For each query prefix, output the matching product count on a new line.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
4 2
mobile phone laptop monitor
mo
lap
Expected Output:
2
1

solution.python:
import sys
tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
if tokens:
    n, q = int(tokens[0]), int(tokens[1])
    words = tokens[2:n+2]
    queries = tokens[n+2:n+2+q]
    for query in queries:
        print(sum(1 for w in words if w.startswith(query)))
